title: Chapter 1274
text:
Just as Mahel was doubting his life, in the venue a few corridors away, the remote projections of the Beyond Grade A members landed in their seats one after another, chatting in twos and threes.

"Another welcome party today? I remember the last newcomer was Aurora. It was only half a year ago. "

"I don't know if you guys feel it, but the frequency of Beyond Grade As being born in the past few decades seems to have increased a lot."

"Indeed. I remember a long time ago, it was already not bad for three or four Beyond Grade As to be born in the past few decades, but in the past few decades, eight Beyond Grade As have been born. Although this is very random, it still proves that the times are improving."

"That's right. The population of the galactic society is increasing exponentially, and the research on the Super system in the universe is becoming more and more complete. The Beyond Grade A seeds have also reached a critical point. With many factors, I feel that there will be an explosion of new Beyond Grade As."

Before the start of the meeting, it was customary for the members to communicate. Everyone chatted casually, and it was a lively scene.

Han Xiao's projection sat on the main seat and smiled at this harmonious scene.

Looking at how clueless everyone was, Han Xiao's lips curled up … These people still did not know that something big was about to happen here today.

At this time, someone suddenly changed the topic to Han Xiao.

"A few days ago, I received a warning from the Radiant Federation, strictly forbidding me from spreading Ultimate Knowledge in private. Your Excellency Black Star, are you aware of this?"

Hearing this, many people agreed, saying that they had also received a warning from the three Universal Civilizations. They all looked at Han Xiao.

Han Xiao glanced at the direct members of the three Universal Civilizations beside him, nodded, and said, "I had a talk with the heads of the three Universal Civilizations not long ago. They hope that I can rectify this situation and stop the spreading of Ultimate Knowledge in private."

"How did you answer?" Manison asked calmly from the side.

"The three Universal Civilizations maintain the order of the galactic society. I will try my best to cooperate with their work without affecting the operation of the association," Han Xiao said with a smile.

Manison snorted. He knew that with how slick Han Xiao was, he would not reject the three Universal Civilizations outright. The most likely scenario was that he would agree verbally.

At this time, a direct descendant spoke, "How do you plan to deal with this problem?"

"I haven't decided yet. Do you have any suggestions?" Han Xiao turned to look at him.

"I feel that one of the reasons for the private dissemination of Ultimate Knowledge is that the rules of the association are too lax. There are no clear restrictions on this behavior. I suggest that we improve the rules and severely punish those who disseminate Ultimate Knowledge …"

When the Direct Descendant spoke, the other normal Association members all tacitly shut their mouths and exchanged glances.

The interests of the direct descendants were different from those of normal Beyond Grade As. These were the two factions with the clearest boundaries. As the three Universal Civilizations became more and more dissatisfied with the actions of the Beyond Grade A Association, the differences between the two factions grew bigger and bigger. More than once, there were already people privately suggesting that Han Xiao kick the direct descendants out of the association.

Han Xiao listened to the Direct Line's speech for a while before suddenly interrupting him and chuckling.

"These suggestions are not bad. I'll consider them carefully. Let's leave this topic for the next regular meeting. After all, today is a welcoming ceremony. Don't get the priority wrong."

He casually skipped this topic with a meaningful tone.

This direct descendant Beyond Grade A was stunned. Hearing Han Xiao's subtle warning, he could only sit down sullenly.

The other Beyond Grade As, on the other hand, were energized. Getting the priority right was basically saying who was the master of the association. It was a disguised warning to the direct descendants not to think that the three Universal Civilizations could order them around.

With Han Xiao's vague reply, many people relaxed a little. Because Black Star's relationship with the three Universal Civilizations was not shallow, some people were still uneasy, afraid that Black Star would change the tough path of the Mecha Empire and compromise with the three Universal Civilizations.

Seeing this, Kasuyi helped to smooth things over. "The president is right. We're gathered here today to welcome the newcomers. Let's not talk about business."

Hearing this, the atmosphere became cheerful again. Everyone tacitly changed the topic and guessed the newcomers' identities. Some people even started a bet out of boredom.

After arguing for a while, someone found Han Xiao and joked.

"President, the newcomer this time should be Mael, right? It can't be that a new Beyond Grade A officer has appeared in the Black Star Corps, right? "

Han Xiao raised his eyebrows and smiled faintly.

"I can only say … the newcomer this time is definitely someone everyone is familiar with."

Everyone chatted while waiting. After a while, everyone finally arrived.

Seeing this, Han Xiao raised his hand, signaled for everyone to quiet down, and smiled.

He smiled and said, "It's about time. The welcoming ceremony can begin. Be quiet and prepare to welcome the newcomers."

Hearing this, everyone quieted down and turned to look at the side door of the venue. According to tradition, the newcomers would walk out from there.

Not long after, the side door was finally pushed open. Mael walked out and appeared in front of everyone.

Immediately, the crowd began to discuss in low voices.

"It's really Mael. I knew it was him."

"Haha, I guessed right. Don't go back on your word."

"Eh, why does he look weird?"

Everyone sized Mael up and soon noticed something strange. Mael's face was dull, as if his soul had wandered out of his body. He did not move at all, as if he did not put anyone in his eyes.

"What's the meaning of this person standing there and not coming over?"

"Why isn't he saying anything? Is he mute?"

Everyone was baffled.

However, at this moment, another figure walked out from behind the door, followed by a second, a third … Soon, dozens of people walked out and squeezed Mael to the side.

"W-what's going on? Isn't this the welcoming ceremony? "

Everyone at the scene was stunned and confused.

This time, Han Xiao smiled and slowly said, "Don't be surprised.

"There's no need to be surprised. These people are all newcomers to the association. Everyone, please welcome them."

As soon as he said that, everyone was dumbfounded, with a 'are you f * cking kidding me' expression. Even the direct members of the three Universal Civilizations who were watching silently widened their eyes in shock.

Without any prior notice, they had thought that today was a normal welcoming ceremony. They did not expect such an unexpected situation to occur.

Every Welcome Party was specially held for one person. When had they ever accepted so many newcomers at once?

Furthermore, since when were there so many new Beyond Grade As in the universe? This number was almost one-third of the association! This was simply impossible!

Could it be that today is some kind of festival, so the president is purposely teasing us?

That must be it!

As this thought flashed through everyone's mind, they subconsciously sized up the dozens of 'newcomers'. Suddenly, they trembled.

"Wait, these people look so familiar!"

"They're … the Primordial Ones?"

"How is that possible? The Primordial Ones have been dead for so many years. They must be pretending to be like this!"

"Oh my, they look exactly the same. Their disguise skills are too good!"

Everyone hurriedly went online to search for information about the Primordial Ones. When they matched up with the revivors present, they could not help but be surprised.

Manison frowned and looked at Han Xiao. "What do you mean by this? Deliberately finding a group of people to pretend to be the Primordial Ones and even asking them to join the association? What are you doing?"

"You think it's fake too?"

Han Xiao glanced at him and was not surprised. After all, in the eyes of those who did not know, this was too unbelievable. Any normal person would be suspicious.

He slowly stood up and looked around at the audience. The smile on his face gradually widened as he said resolutely, "

"I know everyone has doubts, but the group of people you see are the Beyond Grade As who existed in history. They rose from the grave of time, brushed away the dust of history, and came back to life. In the end, they decided to join the association and shine for the entire Beyond Grade A class!"

As soon as he said that, the place fell so silent that one could hear a pin drop.

All the Beyond Grade As present were stunned. Their faces were filled with 'you're f * cking kidding me'.

Only one person was an exception. Kasuyi was so excited that his entire body was trembling. He was another person who knew about the Sanctum Revival, so he immediately connected the dots.

Could this be the result of Black Star disappearing for four months?

"… Tell me, is this true?" Kasuyi turned his head and stared at Han Xiao. He could not wait to know the answer, afraid that this was just a joke.

Han Xiao looked back at him with a tacit understanding and slowly said, "I swear on my promise.

"I swear on my reputation that I'm not joking with anyone today!"

At this moment, ecstasy, shock, admiration, and other emotions exploded in Kasuyi's heart!

At this moment, there was only one thought left in his mind …

Black Star … he succeeded!

At this moment, Beiger, who was the leader, chuckled and stepped forward. He met everyone's bewildered gazes and said calmly,

"Juniors, the times … have changed!"

As soon as he said that, dozens of Beyond Grade As soared into the sky. This time, they did not hold back at all!

Boom!

With a loud sound, the ceiling of the entire venue was suddenly blown away, and the ground and walls cracked inch by inch!

A huge pressure suddenly swept across the entire planet. At this moment, all the living beings on Planet Finn were pressed to the ground by the pressure, and an ear-piercing alarm rang through the sky!

The Beyond Grade As present were all remote projections, so they could not feel the impact on the spot. However, everyone had an office on Planet Finn.

Almost at the same time, everyone received an emergency detection report from the office. Every radar detection showed dozens of Beyond Grade A energy sources, and the targets were these dozens of people! There was no better evidence than this!

At this moment, all the members present had a drastic change in expression. They were in disbelief and shock.

This is actually true? The Primordial Ones are really alive?

How is this possible?

Everyone was stunned!

An irresistible impact instantly shattered their worldview, leaving only endless confusion.

At this moment, there were almost no words that could describe the shock in their hearts.

Even Manison was stunned for a few seconds. He suddenly turned around and stared at Han Xiao.

"What did you do? How did they come back to life? "

Everyone seemed to have woken up from a dream, and their shocked gazes landed on Han Xiao.

These revivors were all recommended by Black Star to join the guild, so he definitely had something to do with it. He definitely knew all the details!

"Black Star, what's going on?"

"Answer us!"

"Say something!"

One after another, they could not wait to know the answer.

Looking at the excited crowd, Han Xiao smiled and slowly opened his mouth. Finally, the truth was revealed.

"In this world, there's a special Information Form phenomenon called 'Sanctum Revival'. As long as you step into the Beyond Grade A realm, you'll be able to leave a record. Even if you die an unnatural death without leaving anything behind, someone else can trigger this phenomenon and come back to life.

There's only one chance for this, and it's equivalent to giving all Beyond Grade As a second life. I'm using this phenomenon to revive them in the grave of history! "

After receiving an affirmative answer, everyone was stunned.

Then, shock and ecstasy exploded in everyone's minds!

There's actually such a miraculous phenomenon in the universe that works on Beyond Grade As? Could it be another Space Wonder?!

Everyone realized that this was a blessing for the entire Beyond Grade A realm!

If they had heard of such a thing, they would most likely have scoffed at it and would not have believed it. However, with a living example in front of them, it proved that Han Xiao was not lying.

The next second, the way everyone looked at Han Xiao changed.

Black Star had revived so many Primordial Ones, which meant that he had grasped how to use it. He had mentioned the mechanism but did not explain how to use the Sanctum Revival. So, for now, Black Star was probably the only way for them to enjoy the 'Sanctum Revival'?

Thinking about it from another perspective, Black Star had only been the president for about half a year. Logically speaking, he should have grasped the Sanctum Revival method long ago. If he had not become the president, he might have kept it a secret …

At this moment, everyone felt that choosing Black Star as the president was the wisest decision!

Han Xiao glanced at everyone, took in their expressions, and chuckled.

"Since everyone is no longer suspicious, don't forget the theme of today's welcome party …"

As he spoke, Han Xiao raised his hand, and the seats at the round table began to adjust. Rows of new seats extended from the ground, which were reserved for the Revivors. Then, he was the first to applaud.

"Everyone, welcome the return of the old era with me."
